title: papaver rhoeas subsp. polytrichum
intro: Papaver rhoeas subsp. polytrichum, commonly known as Flanders poppy or Corn poppy, is a plant species belonging to the poppy family (Papaveraceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation, alleviating pain, and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Papaver rhoeas subsp. polytrichum include alkaloids, such as papaverine and noscapine, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including sedation, analgesia, and vasodilation. The therapeutic actions of this plant also include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
